apiVersion: v3.2.0
kind: DataContract
id: example-shop-orders
name: orders
version: 1.0.0
status: draft
description:
  purpose: One row per order line. An order has several lines.
servers:
  - server: dev
    type: bigquery
    environment: dev
    project: example-project-dev
    dataset: example_shop
    location: europe-west2
schema:
  - name: orders
    physicalName: orders
    physicalType: table
    description: One row per order line. An order has several lines.
    properties:
      - name: order_id
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: STRING
        required: true
        primaryKey: true
        primaryKeyPosition: 1
        description: Identifier of the order. Repeats across the lines of an order.
      - name: line_no
        logicalType: integer
        physicalType: INT64
        required: true
        primaryKey: true
        primaryKeyPosition: 2
        description: Line number within the order.
      - name: sku
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: STRING
        required: true
        description: Stock keeping unit of the item on this line.
      - name: quantity
        logicalType: integer
        physicalType: INT64
        required: true
        description: Number of units ordered on this line.
      - name: unit_price
        logicalType: number
        physicalType: NUMERIC
        required: true
        description: Price per unit for this line.
      - name: ordered_at
        logicalType: timestamp
        physicalType: TIMESTAMP
        required: true
        description: Time the order was placed.
